name: Alligator
summary: This EA trades based on the Bill Williams Alligator indicator, which uses three smoothed moving averages (Jaw, Teeth, Lips) to identify trend direction and dormancy periods. It enters long positions when the Lips cross above the Teeth and Jaw indicating an uptrend, and enters short positions when the Lips cross below indicating a downtrend. The EA closes positions when the Alligator lines converge or cross in the opposite direction, signaling trend exhaustion.
summary_zh: 该EA基于比尔·威廉姆斯的鳄鱼指标进行交易，利用三条平滑移动平均线（颚、齿、唇）来识别趋势方向和休眠期。当唇线上穿齿线和颚线时做多，当唇线下穿时做空。当鳄鱼线收敛或反向交叉时平仓，表明趋势耗尽。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于比尔·威廉姆斯鳄鱼指标，通过三条不同周期的平滑移动平均线的排列和分离程度来判断市场趋势状态。入场条件为：当唇线（短周期）上穿齿线（中周期）且齿线在颚线（长周期）之上时开多单；当唇线下穿齿线且齿线在颚线之下时开空单。出场条件为：当三条线开始收敛交织（鳄鱼闭合嘴）时平仓，表示趋势结束或进入震荡期。仓位管理通常采用固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算方式。资金管理方面，该EA依赖趋势持续获利，在鳄鱼线分离扩大时持仓，收敛时退出，但没有明确止损机制，完全依赖指标信号平仓。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于典型的趋势跟踪系统，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Bill Williams Alligator indicator, which uses the arrangement and separation of three smoothed moving averages with different periods to determine market trend states. Entry conditions: go long when the Lips (short-period) cross above the Teeth (medium-period) and the Teeth is above the Jaw (long-period); go short when the Lips cross below the Teeth and the Teeth is below the Jaw. Exit conditions: close positions when the three lines begin to converge and intertwine (Alligator closing its mouth), signaling trend exhaustion or transition to a ranging market. Position sizing typically uses either fixed lots or a balance-based percentage calculation. In terms of money management, the EA relies on trend continuation for profit, holding positions when the Alligator lines diverge and exiting when they converge, but lacks an explicit stop-loss mechanism, relying entirely on indicator signals for position closure. The overall strategy logic is clear and represents a classic trend-following system, but it is prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in choppy or ranging markets where the Alligator lines repeatedly cross.

parameters.name: JawPeriod
parameters.description: 颚线周期（长周期平滑移动平均）

parameters.name: TeethPeriod
parameters.description: 齿线周期（中周期平滑移动平均）

parameters.name: LipsPeriod
parameters.description: 唇线周期（短周期平滑移动平均）

parameters.name: JawShift
parameters.description: 颚线偏移量（向右平移的K线数）

parameters.name: TeethShift
parameters.description: 齿线偏移量（向右平移的K线数）

parameters.name: LipsShift
parameters.description: 唇线偏移量（向右平移的K线数）

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术号，用于区分不同EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number to identify its own orders

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于经典比尔·威廉姆斯理论，易于理解和验证
趋势行情中表现良好，鳄鱼线分离能有效捕捉中长期趋势
参数直观，三条线的周期和偏移可灵活调整适应不同市场和周期
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on the well-established Bill Williams theory, easy to understand and verify
Performs well in trending markets where Alligator line divergence effectively captures medium-to-long-term trends
Intuitive parameters allowing flexible adjustment of line periods and shifts for different markets and timeframes
cons: 震荡市场中频繁产生虚假信号，导致连续小额亏损
缺乏明确的止损机制，完全依赖指标信号平仓，存在较大回撤风险
鳄鱼指标本质是滞后指标，入场时机偏晚，可能错过趋势初段行情
cons_en: Generates frequent false signals in ranging/choppy markets, leading to consecutive small losses
Lacks an explicit stop-loss mechanism, relying entirely on indicator signals for exits, which creates significant drawdown risk
The Alligator is inherently a lagging indicator, causing late entries that may miss the initial portion of a trend
improvements: 增加明确的止损和止盈机制，防止单笔亏损过大
加入趋势强度过滤器（如ADX），在弱趋势环境下减少交易频率
加入新K线检查机制，避免同一根K线内重复开仓
improvements_en: Add explicit stop-loss and take-profit mechanisms to limit per-trade losses
Incorporate a trend strength filter (e.g., ADX) to reduce trading frequency in weak-trend environments
Add a new bar check mechanism to prevent repeated position opening within the same candle

risk_points: 缺乏硬止损，在极端行情下可能面临大幅回撤
震荡市中连续虚假信号导致资金持续消耗
指标滞后性导致入场偏晚，趋势反转时可能来不及退出
risk_points_en: No hard stop-loss, potentially facing significant drawdowns during extreme market movements
Consecutive false signals in ranging markets lead to persistent capital erosion
Indicator lag causes late entries, and exits may be too slow during trend reversals
